# Accept invitation
{: .no_toc }

Activate an account an admin created: set password and sign in.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-07` |
| **Route** | `/invite` · deep link `substratal://invite` |
| **Who can use it** | Invitation-token holder |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** Deep link `/invite?token=…` from the invitation email

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Display name | text-field | body.display_name | optional | AdwEntryRow |
| Password | password-field | body.password | strength meter | AdwPasswordEntryRow |
| Accept and continue | primary-button | POST /auth/invitations/accept |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Accept and continue | `POST /auth/invitations/accept` | 200 AuthSession → APP-01. 400 → "This invitation is no longer valid. Ask your admin to resend it." |
